name: original_equation_iff_numerator_zero
statement:
theorem original_equation_iff_numerator_zero (X Y z r : ℂ)
    (hX : X≠0) (hY : Y≠0) (hz : z≠0) (hDx : X-3*z-9≠0)
    (hDy : Y-3*z-9≠0) (hDz : X+Y+z^2+3*z≠0)
    (hq : Y*r^2= -X*(9-z^2-X-Y)) :
    (pureNewtonPolynomial66 (zeroSide X Y z r 1) (zeroSide X Y z r (-1))=0 ↔
      computedNumerator X Y z=0)

name: binary_interpret_eq
statement:
theorem binary_interpret_eq (X Y : R) (as bs cs : List DenseCoefficients.XY)
    (hl : (DenseCoefficients.mul as bs).length=cs.length)
    (h : ∀ n : ℕ, n<cs.length →
      zeroII (Coefficients.add2 (mulAt as bs n) (Coefficients.neg2 (cs.getD n [])))=true) :
    DenseCoefficients.interpret X Y (DenseCoefficients.mul as bs)=
      DenseCoefficients.interpret X Y cs

name: binary_eval_eq
statement:
theorem binary_eval_eq (X Y z : R) (as bs cs : List DenseCoefficients.XY)
    (hl : (DenseCoefficients.mul as bs).length=cs.length)
    (h : ∀ n : ℕ, n<cs.length →
      zeroII (Coefficients.add2 (mulAt as bs n) (Coefficients.neg2 (cs.getD n [])))=true) :
    Coefficients.eval z (DenseCoefficients.interpret X Y cs)=
      Coefficients.eval z (DenseCoefficients.interpret X Y as)*
      Coefficients.eval z (DenseCoefficients.interpret X Y bs)
